+class RepairError(RuntimeError):
+    """Fail-closed validation error."""

+def require(condition: bool, code: str) -> None:
+    if not condition:
+        raise RepairError(code)

+def canonical_bytes(value: Any) -> bytes:
+    return json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True, indent=2).encode() + b"\n"
+
+
+def sha256_bytes(value: bytes) -> str:
+    return hashlib.sha256(value).hexdigest()
+
+
+def sha256_file(path: Path) -> str:
+    digest = hashlib.sha256()
+    with path.open("rb") as handle:
+        for chunk in iter(lambda: handle.read(1024 * 1024), b""):
+            digest.update(chunk)
+    return digest.hexdigest()
+
+
+def load_json(path: Path) -> Any:
+    return json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
+
+
+def load_jsonl(path: Path) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
+    return [json.loads(line) for line in path.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines() if line]
+
+
+def content_receipt(value: dict[str, Any], field: str = "content_sha256") -> dict[str, Any]:
+    result = copy.deepcopy(value)
+    result.pop(field, None)
+    result[field] = sha256_bytes(canonical_bytes(result))
+    return result
+
+
+def index(items: list[dict[str, Any]], key: str) -> dict[str, dict[str, Any]]:
+    result = {item[key]: item for item in items}
+    require(len(result) == len(items), f"duplicate_{key}")
+    return result
+

+def authenticate_inputs(paths: dict[str, Path]) -> dict[str, bytes]:
+    require(set(paths) == set(PACKETS), "packet_set_mismatch")
+    payloads: dict[str, bytes] = {}
+    for name, expected in PACKETS.items():
+        payload = paths[name].read_bytes()
+        require(sha256_bytes(payload) == expected, f"packet_hash_mismatch:{name}")
+        payloads[name] = payload
+    return payloads

+def canonical_bytes(value: Any) -> bytes:
+    return json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True, indent=2).encode() + b"\n"
+
+
+def sha256_bytes(value: bytes) -> str:
+    return hashlib.sha256(value).hexdigest()
+
+
+def sha256_file(path: Path) -> str:
+    digest = hashlib.sha256()
+    with path.open("rb") as handle:
+        for chunk in iter(lambda: handle.read(1024 * 1024), b""):
+            digest.update(chunk)
+    return digest.hexdigest()
+
+
+def load_json(path: Path) -> Any:
+    return json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
+
+
+def load_jsonl(path: Path) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
+    return [json.loads(line) for line in path.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines() if line]
+
+
+def content_receipt(value: dict[str, Any], field: str = "content_sha256") -> dict[str, Any]:
+    result = copy.deepcopy(value)
+    result.pop(field, None)
+    result[field] = sha256_bytes(canonical_bytes(result))
+    return result
+

+def index(items: list[dict[str, Any]], key: str) -> dict[str, dict[str, Any]]:
+    result = {item[key]: item for item in items}
+    require(len(result) == len(items), f"duplicate_{key}")
+    return result

+def authenticate_inputs(paths: dict[str, Path]) -> dict[str, bytes]:
+    require(set(paths) == set(PACKETS), "packet_set_mismatch")
+    payloads: dict[str, bytes] = {}
+    for name, expected in PACKETS.items():
+        payload = paths[name].read_bytes()
+        require(sha256_bytes(payload) == expected, f"packet_hash_mismatch:{name}")
+        payloads[name] = payload
+    return payloads

+def canonical_bytes(value: Any) -> bytes:
+    return json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True, indent=2).encode() + b"\n"

+def sha256_bytes(value: bytes) -> str:
+    return hashlib.sha256(value).hexdigest()
+
+
+def sha256_file(path: Path) -> str:
+    digest = hashlib.sha256()
+    with path.open("rb") as handle:
+        for chunk in iter(lambda: handle.read(1024 * 1024), b""):
+            digest.update(chunk)
+    return digest.hexdigest()
+

+def load_json(path: Path) -> Any:
+    return json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))

+    return [json.loads(line) for line in path.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines() if line]

+def content_receipt(value: dict[str, Any], field: str = "content_sha256") -> dict[str, Any]:
+    result = copy.deepcopy(value)
+    result.pop(field, None)
+    result[field] = sha256_bytes(canonical_bytes(result))
+    return result

+def index(items: list[dict[str, Any]], key: str) -> dict[str, dict[str, Any]]:
+    result = {item[key]: item for item in items}

+    return result

+def authenticate_inputs(paths: dict[str, Path]) -> dict[str, bytes]:

+        payloads[name] = payload

+    require(
+        ledger["active_family_counts"]

+            "Integration Techniques": 16,
+            "Trigonometric Manipulation / Equations": 16,
+        },
+        "selection_family_drift",
+    )
+    require(
+        len(ledger["active_question_ids"]) == len(set(ledger["active_question_ids"])) == 48,

+    imported = load_json(root / "evidence/external-packet-import.v3.json")

+    require(imported["fresh_exact_repair_head_review_required"], "exact_head_review_bypassed")
+    contradictions = load_json(root / "layer-b/contradiction-ledger.v3.json")
+    require(contradictions["unresolved_count"] == 27, "contradiction_conservation")
+    require(

+            item["state"] == "unresolved"
+            and item["resolver_decision_ref"] is None
+            and item["approval_effect"] == "none"
+            for item in contradictions["records"]

+    procedure = load_json(root / "layer-c/procedure-candidates.v3.json")

+class RepairError(RuntimeError):
+    """Fail-closed validation error."""
+
+
+def require(condition: bool, code: str) -> None:
+    if not condition:
+        raise RepairError(code)

+def canonical_bytes(value: Any) -> bytes:
+    return json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True, indent=2).encode() + b"\n"
+
+
+def sha256_bytes(value: bytes) -> str:
+    return hashlib.sha256(value).hexdigest()
+
+
+def sha256_file(path: Path) -> str:
+    digest = hashlib.sha256()
+    with path.open("rb") as handle:
+        for chunk in iter(lambda: handle.read(1024 * 1024), b""):
+            digest.update(chunk)
+    return digest.hexdigest()
+
+
+def load_json(path: Path) -> Any:
+    return json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
+
+
+def load_jsonl(path: Path) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
+    return [json.loads(line) for line in path.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines() if line]
+
+
+def content_receipt(value: dict[str, Any], field: str = "content_sha256") -> dict[str, Any]:
+    result = copy.deepcopy(value)
+    result.pop(field, None)
+    result[field] = sha256_bytes(canonical_bytes(result))
+    return result
+
+
+def index(items: list[dict[str, Any]], key: str) -> dict[str, dict[str, Any]]:
+    result = {item[key]: item for item in items}
+    require(len(result) == len(items), f"duplicate_{key}")
+    return result
+

+def authenticate_inputs(paths: dict[str, Path]) -> dict[str, bytes]:
+    require(set(paths) == set(PACKETS), "packet_set_mismatch")
+    payloads: dict[str, bytes] = {}
+    for name, expected in PACKETS.items():
+        payload = paths[name].read_bytes()
+        require(sha256_bytes(payload) == expected, f"packet_hash_mismatch:{name}")
+        payloads[name] = payload
+    return payloads

+                "9709-semantic-stage2-walking-1703-run-v1",
+                "9709-semantic-stage2-walking-1703-run-v2",
+            ],
+            "base_head": BASE_HEAD,
+            "reviewed_predecessor_head": REVIEWED_HEAD,
+            "shared_tree": REVIEWED_TREE,
+            "prior_artifacts_modified": 0,
+        }),
+        "selection/dual-ledger.v3.json": ledger,
+        "authority/source-render-custody.v3.json": source,
+        "evidence/external-packet-import.v3.json": import_receipt,
+        "layer-b/contradiction-ledger.v3.json": contradictions,
+        "layer-c/procedure-candidates.v3.json": procedures,

+        "delta/run-v2-to-run-v3.v1.json": content_receipt({
+            "schema_version": "9709_stage2_run_delta.v1",
+            "from_run": "9709-semantic-stage2-walking-1703-run-v2",

+    }
+    return documents, payloads
+
+
+def validate_render_reconstruction(root: Path) -> int:
+    import fitz  # Imported only for the explicit, bounded render replay.
+
+    render = load_json(root / "external/render-manifest.json")
+    source_documents = index(
+        load_json(RUN_V2 / "authority/source-documents.v2.json")["documents"],
+        "source_object_id",
+    )
+    opened: dict[str, Any] = {}
+    try:
+        for page in render["pages"]:
+            source_id = page["source_object_id"]
+            document = source_documents[source_id]
+            source_path = REPO / document["source_path"]
+            require(sha256_file(source_path) == document["source_sha256"], f"render_source_drift:{source_id}")
+            if source_id not in opened:
+                opened[source_id] = fitz.open(source_path)
+            png = opened[source_id][page["physical_pdf_page"] - 1].get_pixmap(
+                matrix=fitz.Matrix(2.0, 2.0),
+                alpha=False,
+            ).tobytes("png")
+            require(
+                sha256_bytes(png) == page["render_sha256"],
+                f"render_reconstruction_mismatch:{page['render_path']}",
+            )
+    finally:
+        for document in opened.values():
+            document.close()
+    return len(render["pages"])
+
+
+def validate_documents(root: Path, *, verify_renders: bool = False) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    manifest = load_json(root / "artifact-manifest.v3.json")
+    require(manifest["schema_version"] == "9709_stage2_artifact_manifest.v3", "manifest_schema")
+    for item in manifest["files"]:
+        path = root / item["path"]
+        require(path.is_file(), f"artifact_missing:{item['path']}")
+        require(sha256_file(path) == item["sha256"], f"artifact_hash_mismatch:{item['path']}")
